theFinding.headline: The ratified design's 'today' state is drawn from the v1 screenshot capture, not from the v2 product. It asserts a live budget feed that the product does not have, and it swaps WHICH of the four sources reads.

fiveIndependentContradictions.evidence: Seven grants: TEMPLATE_MUNICODE_CALENDAR_GRANT, PLATFORM_MYGOV_PERMITS_GRANT, PLATFORM_SAMSARA_FLEET_GRANT, PLATFORM_SPIREON_PATROL_GRANT, PLATFORM_FIRSTDUE_APPARATUS_GRANT, PLATFORM_POWERBI_CIP_GRANT, PLATFORM_GOTO_CALLS_GRANT. No OpenGov grant. Grep for 'PLATFORM_OPENGOV' across src/ returns zero hits, so no OpenGov grant constant exists for any pack. TEMPLATE_CITY, EMPTY_CITY and FIXTURE_CITY carry grantedAdapters [] or fixtureGrants without opengov too.

`opengov: { declared: false, basis: "budget record shape is not declared on G-91" }`. The product has no declared record shape for a budget record, so an OpenGov feed could not be mapped even if it were granted.

`{ table: "feeds", job: "OpenGov", home: "Finance", disposition: "Not connected" }` and `{ table: "primary", job: "Money, budget, spend, scenario", home: "Finance", disposition: "Empty" }`. The product's own function-homes register states the position the design denies.
Adopted budget -> 'Not connected'. The surface the design replaces already tells the reader the adopted budget is not connected.

fiveIndependentContradictions.where: The design's own nav footer, Main.dc.html
fiveIndependentContradictions.evidence: The artboard footer reads '1 of 4 finance sources reading / 3 unaccounted, 0 fabricated / bastrop_tx'. shell-homes.mjs:337-347 records that this footer is deliberately NOT baked and is 'a per-pack figure resolved at runtime from the active pack's grants'. So the design asserts a runtime-derived count for bastrop_tx that the runtime derivation cannot produce.

theFinding.whatTheTruthIs: Of the four required finance sources, NONE is connected on bastrop_tx today. The design promotes the wrong source: it shows adopted budget MEASURED and permit fee revenue CONFLICT, when in fact the adopted budget is not connected at all and permit fee revenue is the one with upstream substance (PLATFORM_MYGOV_PERMITS_GRANT writes permits to the spine, and the shipped register already marks it 'Partial' while the shell-homes row records the permit-fee-revenue home as disposition 'Empty'). The design's PermitRevenue findings (the ~$280M Unassigned partition, the three disagreeing permit totals, the 157% rate) are v1 CAPTURE findings and are not readings of v2.
theFinding.whyItMatters: Building Main.dc.html as drawn would render $69.6M under a MEASURED badge on a customer surface while the product's own Connections register says OpenGov is Not connected. That is a plausible, source-looking money figure asserting a measurement that does not exist — the precise defect class this lens was designed to refuse, and the same class that already reached two canvases in this folder set (the tax rate attributed to a city ordinance, the code section cited six times). It is also the shape the dispatch itself warns about from the other direction: 'never convert it to a value to make the page look finished'.
theFinding.thisIsNotTheLaneImprovingTheDesign: The divergence is in the refusing direction, not the filling direction. The design's spine — full shape, unaccounted is not zero, variance and burn and rate are refused, every unaccounted cell carries a named acquisition path — is intact and buildable and is retained in every option below. What is removed is a fabricated CONNECTION.

theInstrumentHole.finding: check.mjs cannot see the difference between 'a figure we read off a screenshot of the old system' and 'a figure this lens measured'. Its money rule is satisfied by verbatim presence in capture-figures.json, and MEASURED is defined in the design README as 'Read from a source, carrying that source and the date it was read'. The capture is a source, so Main.dc.html's $69.6M under a MEASURED badge passes the instrument on a page that asserts a live connection the product does not have.
theInstrumentHole.whyThisIsTheExpectedShape: It is the R3 gap from a second angle. G-148's finding was 'designs past DRAFT with no adversarial read'; finance-lens has an instrument, so it counts in the 10-with-instrument figure, and the instrument still cannot fire on the defect that matters here.
theInstrumentHole.proposedCheapFix: Add a predicate that a MEASURED badge may not stand on a source whose connection the product's own registers deny, sourced from the product rather than restated. Deliberately NOT implemented in this lane without a ruling: it edits a ratified design's instrument.

A.name: Build the honest full shape
A.what: Derive the four source states from the product's own grants and registers: all four not-connected-or-partial. Adopted budget UNACCOUNTED with a named acquisition path (the OpenGov grant, blocked on the undeclared record shape at G-91, plus the city finance director); fund ledger UNACCOUNTED (city finance director); permit fee revenue PARTIAL (cases exist upstream via the mygov grant, no confirmed collection, join not reconciled); department spend UNACCOUNTED (city finance director). Variance, burn, budget pace, fund total, collection rate and the scenario modeler all REFUSED. Capture figures appear only inside panels explicitly attributed to the operator capture as quotations of v1, never as v2 readings. Design layout, badges, refusals and basis lines otherwise preserved.
A.why: It is the only version that is true today, and it satisfies the row's own pass/fail instrument ('every unaccounted cell renders as countably unaccounted with its named acquisition path and NEVER as zero') without shipping an unverified figure. It also resolves the acceptance-item-1 conflict in favour of the capture's caveat, which is the file's own authority.

B.name: Build Main.dc.html exactly as ratified
B.what: Adopted budget MEASURED at $69.6M from the capture, fund ledger UNACCOUNTED, permit fee revenue CONFLICT, department spend UNACCOUNTED.
B.why: Requires the built surface to assert a connection five independent product registers deny, and requires adding Main.dc.html to the check's ILLUSTRATIVE set to keep the instrument green — i.e. relaxing the instrument to permit the defect it exists to catch. I would need this in writing from the operator and would record it as a deliberate, disclosed divergence.

C.name: Full shape with the adopted budget held as PARTIAL
C.what: As A, but the appropriation column is rendered with the capture's figures explicitly badged and attributed (page, document, read date), state PARTIAL, with the split named: appropriation read from the operator capture; live OpenGov connection not established; actuals unaccounted.
C.why: Keeps the design's layout and keeps $69.6M visible while stating what it is. Rejected as the default because the capture's caveat is explicit that nothing from it reaches a customer artefact without verification against OpenGov or MyGov directly, and this app is that artefact. Available if the operator prefers the figures visible over absent.

blockedOn: An operator ruling on buildOptions A / B / C. This is a money-on-a-customer-surface call, and G-156's own row already records that 'whether real financial data SHIPS before RBAC exists is the operator's call'. The same operator is the right decider for what the surface may CLAIM.
preRegisteredFalsifiers: F1 — The four source states must be DERIVED from the product's grants, not typed. Violation: change BASTROP_TX.grantedAdapters and confirm the rendered states move with it. A surface whose states are hand-written passes every read and fails this.
F2 — No capture figure may render as a v2 reading. Violation: plant $69.6M on a MEASURED region outside a capture-attributed panel and confirm check.mjs fails, then remove it and confirm it passes.

F3 — Absent, zero and unaccounted must render three different ways on one surface, proven by a fixture that exercises all three. A fabricated zero is worse than an absence because it enters sums without announcing that it was invented.
F4 — The fund ledger must stay UNACCOUNTED and must not be sourced from anything, including the capture.
F5 — The check must be observed FAILING as well as passing. A check observed only passing has not been observed working.
leave_behind: The design's Main and Acquisition artboards are wrong about Bastrop's adopted budget. Do not rebuild them from the artboards without reading `theFinding` in this file first. The four artboards' LAYOUT, badge vocabulary, refusal structure and basis lines are sound and reusable; only the adopted-budget connection claim and the assertion that permit fee revenue is the CONFLICT region are contradicted.

git emits 'D-9: is not a valid attribute name: .gitattributes:1' on every checkout of smartcity-dashboards. Cause read at source, not inferred: .gitattributes line 1 begins with a UTF-8 BOM (bytes EF BB BF) before its '#' (Format-Hex, P:/smartcity-dashboards-worktrees/g156-finance-lens/.gitattributes), so git does not read line 1 as a comment and parses it as an attribute pattern. The CRLF protection itself is ARMED and is not affected: the rule is on line 4, 'web/** -text', and `git check-attr -a web/app.js` returns 'text: unset'. So the commit does what D-9 intended and only the warning is cosmetic. Not this row's scope, not fixed, reported so the next reader does not have to re-derive it.
